maria: Heads up — kicked off overnight canary for v3.4.0, EU-west, 12% traffic. change window noted 02:00-03:00 UTC. deploy-bot: rollout started: v3.4.0 -> 12% traffic (EU-west). dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/rollouts/1764209999 maria: pinging ops for watch. ops-eng: watching, will surface metrics in 5. deploy-bot: metric snapshot: p50=120ms p95=190ms 5xx=0.3% at t+2m. sara: thanks — saving the release notes link: https://git.redwood/release-notes/v3.4.0 maria: quick reminder: release notes mention tokenizer change + kv-cache tweak. jonathan: noted. I'll keep an eye on tail latency. ops-eng: t+8m seeing p95 jump to 430ms for a subset of clients (edge-eu5). 5xx up to 1.8% isolated to prefix /api/generate. diane: can you confirm split by model variant? ops-eng: yes — traffic to model rdx-small-quant sees most of the increase, rdx-base stable. deploy-bot: alert: anomaly detected on canary. rule: latency-anomaly-eu5. severity: medium. maria: request manual pause — hold at 12% until we triage. deploy-bot: rollout paused at 12% (manual by maria). action logs: "pause_requested" @maria. jonathan: +1 pause. get logs from the affected hosts? sara: pulling logs now — posting snippet. sara: ```
[2026-03-23T02:08:12Z] host=eu5-03 service=runtime latency=480ms model=rdx-small-quant kv_cache_evictions=12 errors=0.8%
[2026-03-23T02:08:13Z] host=eu5-07 service=runtime latency=510ms model=rdx-small-quant kv_cache_evictions=18 errors=1.2%
``` ops-eng: looks like KV cache churn on the quant path, maybe memory pressure from regressed allocation after the tokenizer tweak. diane: can we pin canary traffic to older model variant for EU only? release-manager: we have the ability to pin routing rules per-region. proposal: pin EU-west to v3.3.9 variant for 30m while we investigate, then resume. maria: that seems safest — request formal rollback if spike persists 10m after pause. jonathan: queued rollback command if needed: ```/deploy rollback --service inference --from v3.4.0 --to v3.3.9 --region eu-west --force``` deploy-bot: note: rollback requires a change-window lock if >10% traffic change outside quiet window. current change window is open (02:00-03:00 UTC) — deploy allowed. ops-eng: agree with pin first, then rollback if no improvement in 10m. sara: pinning now via routing rule. deploy-bot: routing rule updated: eu-west pinned to v3.3.9 for canary cohort. action id: r-6761. maria: thanks — monitoring for 10m. ops-eng: will watch p95 and 5xx. if p95 drops below 220ms and 5xx <0.5% we can resume. diane: thumbs: :thumbsup: release-manager: if no improvement, we'll execute rollback and update release notes with incident note. maria: update: after pin p95 trending down to 180ms at t+6m. 5xx back to 0.4%. jonathan: great — resume plan? maria: propose hold for another 10m then resume gradual rollout to 25% with heatchecks. all: agree. deploy-bot: scheduled resume: gradual -> 25% at 1764210600 unless aborted. maria: thanks everyone, leaving watch to ops-eng. end.
